verdict.rationale: Whether a public register portal publishes its source code under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that register data and announcements are publicly searchable. Nothing indicates the portal's source code is published or openly licensed. Public data access is a different capability from open source code and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
